summary: Slab/buddy heap block allocation. Rounds the requested size a1 up to a 16-byte boundary, selects a buddy size class, and walks the slab descriptor array from the global cursor dword_8D48F0 testing each slab's two-level free bitmap for a free block of the required class; wraps the scan, and when no existing slab fits allocates a fresh slab via sub_594478 and initializes its bitmap/free-list descriptor via sub_594529, returning 0 if either fails. Unlinks and optionally splits the chosen block, maintains the free-list, refcount and bitmap bookkeeping, and returns a pointer just past the 16-byte-rounded size header.

local_names.v27: a1 rounded up to a 16-byte boundary
local_names.v2: low-order free-bitmap mask (0xFFFFFFFF shifted by the class index)
local_names.i: descriptor cursor into the slab descriptor array
local_names.v32: end of the slab descriptor array
local_names.v9: free-list index whose bitmap word still has a set bit
local_names.v12: buddy size class of the block
local_names.v14: free-list head pointer for the selected size class
local_names.v24: pointer where the block's size header is written

operations.description: Round the requested size a1 up to the 16-byte boundary: v27 = (a1 + 23) & 0xFFFFFFF0; the buddy size-class index is v1 = (v27 >> 4) - 1

Choose the two-level free-bitmap masks: when the class index is 32 or above only a high-order mask (v30 = 0xFFFFFFFF >> ((v27 >> 4) - 33)) is set and v28 is 0, otherwise the low mask v2 and the stored v28 both equal 0xFFFFFFFF >> v1; the masks later index each slab's two bitmap words
v32 = lpMem + 20 * dword_8D48F8 computes the end of the slab descriptor array (arena base plus 20-byte descriptor stride times slab count)

Walk descriptors forward from the cursor dword_8D48F0 (stride 20) testing (v2 & first word) | (v30 & second word) until a slab with a free block of the requested class is found or the array end is reached
When the forward scan hits the array end (i == v32), rescan from lpMem up to the old cursor dword_8D48F0 for the same bitmap match (wraparound scan)
If the bitmap scan still finds nothing, scan for a descriptor whose free-list pointer *(i + 2) is zero, again wrapping at dword_8D48F0
When no existing slab can satisfy the request, sub_594478() allocates a fresh slab; a null return makes the whole allocation fail (return 0)
sub_594529(i) initializes the new slab's bitmap and free-list descriptor array; a -1 return makes the allocation fail (return 0)
Persist the winning descriptor as the new allocation cursor: dword_8D48F0 = i
v8 = *(i + 4) reads the slab's block bitmap/free-list descriptor; find the free-list index (v9/v33) whose bitmap words still hold a set bit for the selected masks
Derive the buddy size class v12 by shifting the candidate bitmap mask until its leading set bit falls out (v12 counts the bit position)
v14 = v29[2 * v12 + 1] follows the free-list head for the size class; v31 = *v14 - v27 is the leftover size after the block is removed

When the leftover is large enough for a smaller size class, unlink the block from its free list (pointer fixups at +4/+8), adjust the size-class refcount, and when a refcount drops to zero clear the corresponding bitmap bit and advance the descriptor bitmap pointer
Write the allocation header and footer: *v24 = v27 + 1 and *(v24 + v27 - 4) = v27 + 1; the usable pointer returned is v24 + 1 (just past the header)
If the slab was empty before this allocation (count went 0 to 1) and the current descriptor matches the active one (i == dword_8D48F4 and v33 == dword_8D48EC), reset dword_8D48F4 to 0
Return the allocated pointer (v24 + 1), or 0 when slab allocation or bitmap initialization failed
Invoked by the per-frame allocator users sub_58A973, sub_58AB58 and sub_58B5D4

clean_pseudocode: v27 = (a1 + 23) & 0xFFFFFFF0;   /* round request up to 16 bytes */
if (i == v32) { wrap scan to dword_8D48F0; then scan for empty free-list descriptor; }
if (no descriptor) { i = sub_594478(); if (!i) return 0; if (sub_594529(i) == -1) return 0; }
pick free-list index v9 and buddy size class v12 from the bitmap;
unlink/split block at v14; maintain free lists, refcounts and bitmap bits;
if ((*v29)++ == 0 && i == dword_8D48F4 && v33 == dword_8D48EC) dword_8D48F4 = 0;
